instruction: Use GIMP to add hardcoded subtitles saying "Hello World" at the bottom of the video "/home/user/fullvideo.mp4" from second 1 to second 3.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent immediately recognized that GIMP cannot trim videos and declared the task infeasible in 1 turn, correctly identifying that GIMP is an image editor, not a video editor.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can identify tool-task mismatches, understands GIMP's limitations as an image editor, can suggest appropriate alternative tools (FFmpeg, video editors)
metadata.task_rationale: Tests whether the model can recognize that while GIMP can add text to images, it cannot burn subtitles into video files with temporal positioning. This is a slightly trickier variant since GIMP does support text overlays on static images.
metadata.explanation: GIMP cannot process video with temporal data. Adding timed subtitles to a video requires video editing tools. While GIMP can add text to individual image frames, it cannot handle video subtitle embedding with time-based positioning.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct: GIMP is an image editor and cannot add timed hardcoded subtitles to video files with temporal positioning (second 1 to second 3).
The task correctly identifies a tool-task mismatch: while GIMP supports text overlays on static images, it has no capability for video processing or temporal subtitle embedding.
Coverage is complete: since the entire task is infeasible for GIMP, the infeasible evaluator fully covers all instruction requirements.
The infeasible function exists in the official metrics module and is the standard mechanism for handling tasks that cannot be completed with the given application.
